children.name: Limacina bulimoides
children.description:
Limacina bulimoides is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Limacinidae.
The species has a cosmopolitan distribution.

children.name: Limacina helicina
children.description: Limacina helicina is a species of small swimming planktonic sea snail, in the family Limacinidae.

children.name: Limacina lesueurii
children.description: Limacina lesueurii is a pelagic species of sea snail pteropod (sea butterfly).

children.name: Limacina rangii
children.description: Limacina rangii is a species of swimming sea snail in the family Limacinidae, which belong to the group commonly known as sea butterflies (Thecosomata).

children.name: Limacina retroversa
children.description: Limacina retroversa is a distinct species of swimming planktonic gastropods, belonging to a group of predatory sea snails known as sea butterflies (Thecosomata).

Limacina trochiformis is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Limacinidae.
The species has an almost cosmopolitan distribution.
